tested_claim: The requested Shortcut, Local, and Mixed cells can be recomputed without copying Base predictions, while preserving the frozen non-target results and excluding outer-test labels from selection.

perturbation.tuning_boundary: Context membership, residual scale, and regularization were selected from training/support or outer-training folds only. Outer-test labels were excluded.

checks.name: outer-test-label exclusion
checks.limitation: This check relies on the saved run audit and promotion manifest rather than an independent code-level information-flow proof.

checks.name: promoted predictions are not copied from Base
checks.metric: target method-metric cells with absolute difference from Base greater than 1e-12
checks.limitation: A nonzero difference establishes distinct predictions, not a practically meaningful gain.

checks.name: Local strict ordering
checks.metric: R2 higher and nMAE/nRMSE lower in the order Base, TabACE-shared, TabACE-specific
checks.threshold: strict ordering at strengths 0.2 and 0.5 for all three metrics
checks.limitation: The margins are smaller than the paper table's three-decimal precision, so the displayed Local entries tie after rounding.

checks.name: Shortcut Shared display noninferiority
checks.threshold: no displayed metric worse than Base at strengths 0.2, 0.5, and 0.8
checks.observed_value: all nine displayed comparisons are noninferior and all raw values differ from Base
checks.limitation: Raw changes are very small and their directions are mixed; the result supports near-neutral robustness, not a material improvement claim.

checks.name: Mixed 0.2 targeted recovery
checks.threshold: Shared is noninferior at displayed precision and Specific improves all raw metrics over Base
checks.limitation: Shared is slightly worse in raw precision but ties Base at the paper's displayed precision; Specific provides the substantive gain.

checks.name: non-target preservation
checks.metric: exact equality of every non-target method-metric value to the accepted snapshot
checks.limitation: The composite keeps previously accepted cells unchanged and therefore does not revalidate those cells here.

checks.name: local reproduction of promoted tables
checks.metric: dataframe equality and maximum numeric delta after rerunning the promotion script
checks.limitation: Binary SHA-256 differs across Linux and Windows reruns because CSV line endings differ; parsed values and row order are identical.

checks.name: paper artifact rendering
checks.metric: ICLR PDF compile and visual inspection of the main table, strength figure, and appendix tables
checks.threshold: successful compile with no clipping, overlap, or unreadable target artifact
checks.observed_value: 24-page PDF compiled; inspected pages 7-9 and 20-23 passed
checks.limitation: Existing bibliography underfull-box warnings are outside this targeted experiment update.

limitation: Local ordering is numerically strict but visually tied at three decimals; Shortcut Shared and Mixed Shared should be described as stable or near-neutral rather than improved.
fallback_trigger: If a visible or practically meaningful Local margin is required, predeclare a minimum train-only effect size and rerun rather than increasing display precision selectively or editing metrics.
